// SENTINEL APEX — CVE-2025-68686 Remote Code Execution Detection
// Product: Web Application | Generated: 2026-07-29T07:31:50Z

let lookback = 1d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(lookback)
| where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe", "httpd.exe", "nginx.exe", "tomcat.exe", "java.exe")

| extend Severity = "HIGH", CVE = "CVE-2025-68686", RuleSource = "SENTINEL-APEX"
| order by Timestamp desc
